verdict.rationale: Stripe Treasury documents substantial API coverage of its core operations: FinancialAccount objects, OutboundPayment transfers, ReceivedDebits, funding from payments balances via the Stripe API, and Transaction ledger entries with events. Nothing in the evidence states or shows that the API matches what the Dashboard and mobile app can do, and the docs frame direct-account use around the Dashboard. missing for 10: explicit documentation of API–Dashboard feature parity, evidence that Dashboard-only tasks (e.g. adding recipients, bill pay, feature changes) are exposed via API, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Stripe Treasury for Platforms provides users with a container for money called a FinancialAccount that is separate from their Payments balance.
OutboundPayment objects represent push-based transfers from: A platform’s financial accounts to a financial account owned by connected accounts.
Send funds from a Stripe payments balance | Instant | Stripe API
Every movement of funds into or out of a financial account creates a Transaction object. Transactions are the ledger entries for your financial accounts.
